what: Items within a panel line up and appear one by one as they enter the screen. The next starts only after the set gap (text .18 · panel .22 · card .12s) since the previous one started. Text moves in .5 from 18px below, panels .64 from 20px · .975 scale, cards .5 from 16px · ±.5° · .99 scale alternating left and right, and feature cards .62 from 64px · 22px · ±1.2° · .985 scale alternating left and right (gap .12).
